sloka: स पूज्यमानो रक्षोभिद्दीप्यमानम् स्वतेजसा ।असवस्थम् महाबाहुर्ववन्दे धनदानुजम् ॥६-१०-१०॥।।
transliteration: sa pūjyamāno rakṣobhiddīpyamānam svatejasā ।asavastham mahābāhurvavande dhanadānujam ॥6-10-10॥।।

translations.english: Vibheeshana, of broad shoulders, who is revered by Rakshasas was shining in his own splendour. He greeted with folded palms, the brother of Kubera (Ravana) seated on his chair.
translations.hindi: राज्षसों से आदर पा, विभीषण ने रावण को, जो सिंहासन पर बैठा हुआ था और मारे तेज के चमचमा रहा था, जाते ही प्रणाम किआ
